query:
SELECT id, requestNumber, status, urgencyLevel, orcamentoFeitoUrgente, directorApprovals
FROM purchaseRequests
WHERE requestNumber = 'SOL-2026-0170';

SELECT action, from_status, to_status, createdAt, comment
FROM approvalHistory
WHERE requestId = (SELECT id FROM purchaseRequests WHERE requestNumber = 'SOL-2026-0170')
ORDER BY createdAt DESC
LIMIT 20;
